Perlin noise is a smoothly varying random noise.
Type gives a choice of combination of 2D or 3D, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.

Hexagons makes a hexagonal grid.
Shape sets the profile in each hexagon.
Fold adjusts the position of a fold in the profile.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Bricks makes a grid of brick shapes.
Layout sets the brick pattern.
Mortar sets the gap between bricks.
Dimension chooses 2D or 3D brick shape.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Cell 2D makes 2D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Distance sets the combination of distances to the nearest cell centers.
Metric is how the distance is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.

Cell 3D makes 3D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Distance sets the combination of distances to the nearest cell centers.
Metric is how the distance is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.

Paving 2D makes 2D paving patterns of subdivided blocks.
Shape sets the overall shape of blocks, with variations in amount of splitting.
Height sets how the height of subdivided blocks varies.
Levels sets how many times to split.
Mortar sets the gap between blocks (not for Height Cell ID or Across).
Seed varies the randomness, with negative values for repeated 2x2 patterns.
Profile sets the shape within each block.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Paving 3D makes 3D paving patterns of subdivided blocks.
Shape sets the shape of blocks, with variations in amount of splitting.
Height sets how the height of subdivided blocks varies.
Levels sets how many times to split.
Mortar sets the gap between blocks.
Seed varies the randomness, with negative values for repeated 2x2 patterns.
Profile sets the shape within each block.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Gabor Rand makes random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution.
Min Freq sets the ripple frequency. Ripples are summed if positive, maximum value if negative.
Freq Var is how much the ripple frequency varies randomly; negative to take absolute value of ripples.
Phase Var adds random phase shifts to the impulses.
Angle Var is how much the ripple angle varies randomly.
Profile sets the shape of impulses.

Gabor Tile makes repeating tile patterns with sparse Gabor convolution.
Min Freq sets the ripple frequency. Ripples are summed if negative, otherwise maximum value.
Freq Var is how much the ripple frequency varies, with the pattern if positive or randomly if negative.
Phase Var is how much impulse phase varies in the pattern; negative to use absolute ripple values.
Angle Var varies the ripple angle with the pattern, slightly random if negative.
Pattern sets the tile pattern. 0-30 regular; 31-32 vary smoothly; 33-69 alternate regular and random; 70-199 random framed; 200-400 random 2x2 framed; -1..-199 random 2x2; -200..-400 random.

Karakusa makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Seed varies the random aspects.
Profile sets how the ring height varies.

Scales makes a fish scale pattern.
Shape has choices of scale shape.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Parquet makes traditional floor tiling patterns.
Pattern chooses a tile layout.
Shape sets the relation between pattern and height.
ID Mix blends between the shape and tile ID.
Gaps sets distance between tiles.
Random Mix adds random offsets to the height of each tile.

Cell Ripple2D makes localized circular ripples in a random 2D grid.
Frequency sets the ripple frequency.
Falloff is how fast the ripples reduce from the center.
Height Var varies ripple height randomly.
Phase adjusts the phase of the ripple waves.
Phase Var adds randomness to the phase at each ripple center.

Cell Ripple3D makes localized circular ripples in a random 3D grid.
Frequency sets the ripple frequency.
Falloff is how fast the ripples reduce from the center.
Height Var varies ripple strength randomly.
Phase Var adds randomness to the phase at each ripple center.
Density sets the number of ripple centers in each cube.

Stripes makes randomly connected stripes.
Crossovers sets the percentage of connection between stripes in each pair.
Interlace is how much line pairs interact.
Line Width sets the relative thickness of stripes.
Profile sets the shape of stripe height.
Seed varies the randomness. Negative values make repeating 4x4 patterns.

Cell Stars 2D makes star shapes in a random 2D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Cell Stars 3D makes star shapes in a random 3D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Truchet 1 displaces in one point Truchet patterns in the Z direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Mono Mix blends between linear and binary output.

Truchet 2 displaces in two point Truchet patterns in the Z direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles. Patterns 25 and up are random.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Mono Mix blends between linear and binary output.

Perlin is a smoothly varying random noise.
Type gives a choice of combination of dimensions, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.
Shape adjusts the curvature of the distortion.

Cell 2D distorts with 2D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Mode chooses the distortion pattern.
Metric is how the distance to cells is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.
Shape varies the response curve of the distortion.

Cell 3D distorts with 3D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Mode chooses the distortion pattern.
Metric is how the distance to cells is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.
Shape varies the response curve of the distortion.

Perlin Rad is a smoothly varying random noise with radial orientation.
Type gives a choice of combination of dimensions, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.
Geometry sets cylindrical or spherical displacement.
Curve adjusts the profile of the noise amplitude.
Radial sets how the relative displacement varies with radius.

Mesh makes a triangle mesh, opened from a file.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Face Order sets triangle drawing order. Random is best for previewing, Sequential is smoother and faster.
Scaling options set the mesh to a workable size for the holon scaling to adjust.
Centered automatically centers the mesh.
File is the filename; currently a .obj, .ply, or .stl file.
The maximum number of triangles is currently 10 million.

Planet1 is a spherical terrain made from octaves of Perlin or Simplex noise.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Detail sets whether the roughness is constant or reducing at higher octaves.
Direction limits displacement directions.
Random Seed chooses different random terrains.

Planet2 is a spherical terrain made from octaves of Perlin or Simplex noise, with slope modification.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Slope mod lets you adjust height of octaves depending on the local slope.
Direction limits displacement directions.
Random Seed chooses different random terrains.

Grid Cubic displaces towards the edges of a cubic grid.
Diamonds makes diamond shaped pieces instead of rectangular.
Random adds variation to each cell. Positive to set a threshold for displacing; negative to vary the amount.

Grid Spheric displaces towards a spherical grid.
Diamonds makes diamond shaped pieces instead of rectangular.
The longitude and latitude frequencies can be adjusted independently.
Random adds variation to each cell. Positive to set a threshold for displacing; negative to vary the amount.
Random Seed varies the randomness.

Paving 2D makes random block patterns with Z displacement.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Random Seed changes the randomization. Negative values give regular 2x2 patterns.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Cp Rectangle makes copies in a rectangle along X and Y.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Aspect varies the X spacing.
Stagger offsets alternate rows in X and/or Z.
Alt Rows inverts or rotates copies in alternate rows.
Alt Columns inverts or rotates copies in alternate columns.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Circle makes copies of the holon around a circle or arc.
Copies is the number of copies.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Radius sets the X displacement of the first copy.
Arc is the angle around the circle used for copies.
Orient rotates each copy by its position around the circle.
Rotate Y is the relative rotation around the orbital axis.
Rotate Z is the relative rotation around the circle.
Alternate options reflect alternating copies across the axes (before Rotations).
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Vortices twists the center of cells in a 2D grid facing Z.
Displace moves the central spire in each cell in the Z direction.
Power biases the vortex curvature toward or away from the center.
Random Amt varies the amount per cell.
Shape sets the shape of the boundary for twisting.
Alternate has options for alternating the direction of twisting.

Paving 3D displaces in random block patterns.
The Shapes can be all cubic, mixed dimensions or blocks of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Mortar adds gaps between blocks.
Curve squares up the blocks; set negative to constrain displacement within blocks.
Random Seed changes the randomization.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Cubes or Mixed Shapes.
Profile sets the shape of each block displacement.

Cp Sphere makes copies in a golden spiral around a sphere.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Offset moves the copies radially.
Orient automatically orients each copy away from the center, relative to vertical.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.
Radial Mod varies the radius with a sine wave set by Mod Frequency, negative for Abs Sine.

Cp Fibspire2 makes copies with log Fibonacci spiral packing, flat or in a spire with choice of four shapes.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Conic makes copies in rings in a conic section.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Stagger offsets alternate rings, good for bricks.
Rot Z Vert adds progressive Z rotation per ring.
Rot Z Horz adds progressive Z rotation around the rings.
Rot Y Horz adds progressive Y rotation around the rings.
Alt Ring reflects copies outwards for alternate rings.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cell Split cuts into pieces using 3D cell noise (Voronoi).
Warp bends the pieces towards the cell shape.
Metric determines the shape at each point.
Cell density is the number of points per cell.
Random Seed changes random aspects.

Karakusa Z makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing in Z.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.

Kara Cut Z makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, cutting stencils in the Z plane.
Amount cuts towards the center of rings if positive, or towards the edges if negative.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Prioritize prefers overlapping rings to joins.

Karakusa Ax makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing in the nearest axial direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Face Seed chooses the same or different randomness per face.
Align Grid chooses even or odd grid spacing in each face.

Karakusa Pol makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing radially with polar coordinates.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Geometry gives a choice of cylindrical or spherical coordinates.
Scale sets the pattern size.

Maze Z displaces in a rectangular maze pattern facing Z.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Density adjusts the number of walls.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Periodic sets the size of repeating square blocks.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.

Obelisk Ax makes a grid of square spires displacing in each axis.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Random Ht varies the height randomly.
Quantize Ht limits random height to specific values.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillation for shapes.
Mod Random sets the amount of randomness in mod frequency.
Shape gives choices for the modulation wave.
Vary Aspect lets the widths of spires vary in each direction.
Squares has options for spacing the spires.
Random Seed changes randomized parameters.

Hexagons Z makes a hexagonal grid displacing in Z.
Fold adds triangular oscillations if positive or a single fold if negative.
Flatten adds soft limiting to the top if positive or clipping if negative.
Octaves add repetition at smaller scales.
Freq Ratio adjusts the scale between octaves.
Roughness sets the height ratio between octaves.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Random Octs randomizes octaves with Blend if positive or Roughness if negative.
Floor adds flat space between hexagons.

Bristler displaces radially with sharp or rounded spines.
Random Height varies the bristle height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of bristles.
Shape chooses round or sharp bristles.
Bubble Amount adds oscillation to the bristle thickness.
Bubble Freq adjusts the rate of oscillation, with negative values randomized.
Helix Amount adds a twist to the bristles.
Helix Freq sets the rate of twist, with negative values adding random phase.
Width adjusts the width of the bristles.

Sliders makes randomized sliding windows in a cubic grid.
Directions sets the number of axes to move in.
Move can be in one random direction or all directions.
Move From sets where in each cell to open the window.
Reduction randomly reduces the window in each cell; positive to use a threshold or negative for even distribution.
Random Seed changes the random distribution.
Warp adds triangular shapes to the windows.

Paving Polar makes random block patterns in polar coordinates displacing radially.
Frequency sets the density of the pattern.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Hairwave displaces radially with hairs that bend in various ways.
Random Height varies the hair height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of hairs.
Shape chooses the hair profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Wave Frequency adjusts the rate of wave changes.
Wave Shape gives a choice of wave patterns.
Jitter adds random direction to each hair.
Curve adjusts the bend of the hairs, with a different curve when negative.
Width adjusts the width of the hairs.
Mod Frequency adds sine ripples to the width if positive or scallops if negative.

Frequency adjusts the density of stalks.
Shape chooses the stalk profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Wave Frequency adjusts the rate of wave changes.
Wave Shape gives a choice of wave patterns.

Width adjusts the width of the stalks.

Hairparter displaces radially with hairs that around or towards/away from poles.
Random Height varies the hair height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of hairs.
Shape chooses the hair profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Parting sets the directions of bending.
Jitter adds random sideways shift to the bend of each hair.
Curve adjusts the bend of the hairs, with a different curve when negative.
Width adjusts the width of the hairs.

Botsy displaces vertically with a numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Axibots displaces axially with varied numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Gabor Noise creates random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied by Angle Variation.

Displace adds a rounded displacement to each tile in the Z direction.
Pattern sets the tile pattern.
Gaps creates space between the tiles; positive for equal in each direction, negative for one direction.
Flatten squares up the displacement if positive or truncates the top if negative.
The colors are: direction 1, direction 2, rounded, id 1, id 2, random.

Maze Polar displaces in a polar maze pattern around the Y axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Long Density adjusts the number of longitudinal walls.

Cube Lattice 1 makes a cubic lattice of rods and balls or cubes. Always has effect.
Ball Size is the size of the corner shapes.

Ball Random adds random variation to ball size.
Rod Shape sets the profile of connecting rods.
Rod Size sets the rod thickness.
Mod Shape sets the waveform for rod oscillations.
Mod Amount adds oscillations to the rod thickness.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillations.
Spring adds helical coils to the rods. Negative values make a variable pitch spring.

Maze Circle displaces vertically in a circular maze pattern around the Z axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Outside Corners can be sharp or round.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Num Arms is the number of radial arms.
Num Rings is the number of concentric rings.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Pre-Rotate options change orientation before rotation.
Alt Arms options invert every second arm in specified directions.
Alt Rings options invert every second ring in specified directions.
Rotate X adds rotation of copies around X along the arms.
Twist Z twists the arms around the Z axis.
Orientation rotates positions between a flat ring and a cylinder.

Cp Rings makes copies in concentric rings.
Num Rings is the number of concentric rings.
First Ring is the size of the inner ring.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Pre-Rotate options change orientation before rotation.

Molecular makes a random lattice of rods and balls. Always has effect.

Profile sets the shape of stripe height.

Profile sets the shape of the lines.

Profile sets the shape of the lines.

Scales makes a fish scale pattern.
Shape has choices of scale shape.

Paving 2D makes random block patterns with Z displacement.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.

JuliaN is the 2D complex Julia set Z^N+C.
Power N determines the symmetry. It is invalid between -1.01 and 1.01.
The C values determine the fractal shape.
The Abs(z) option results in fourfold symmetry.

Power N determines the symmetry.
The four quaternion parameters affect the shape.
Note: with constructors, C k should be 0 or the shape gets smeared. It only works properly with a pure quaternion.

Maskit gives variations of a Maskit Kleinian generator repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and Position 0.
The C parameters are the spherical inversion offset (x100). Ideal values depend on the X Interval and Invert Y settings.
Interval Type sets the repetition distance along X. Set to 0 for 3, 1 for 2, more for resonances.
Invert Y to include a reflection of Y in the spherical inversions.
D y adds vertical shift to the horizontal repetitions.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Auger combines stretching, ribs and twisting on each of the six axes.
Amount is the overall change.

Sharpness is how thin the stretching is.
Ribs displaces the four axes along each spine.
Twist rotates around each axis, with a choice of type.
NOTE: reduce Transform Scales for best results.

Paving 3D displaces in random block patterns.

Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Mortar adds gaps between blocks.
Curve squares up the blocks; set negative to constrain displacement within blocks.
Random Seed changes the randomization.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Cubes or Mixed Shapes.
Profile sets the shape of each block displacement.

Penrose Z does Penrose tiling in the Z plane; good for coloring or displacement.
Flatten truncates the pyramid tops when displacing.
Levels is the depth of tile recursion.
Displace Level sets the size for displacement, with 1 being smallest.
Color 4 Blend adjusts blending of up to five levels in the 4th color option.
Note: increasing Scales may be needed to cover large objects, as the pattern is bounded.

Karakusa Ax makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing in the nearest axial direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.

Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Face Seed chooses the same or different randomness per face.
Align Grid chooses even or odd grid spacing in each face.

Karakusa Pol makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing radially with polar coordinates.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Geometry gives a choice of cylindrical or spherical coordinates.
Scale sets the pattern size.

Obelisk Ax makes a grid of square spires displacing in each axis.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Random Ht varies the height randomly.
Quantize Ht limits random height to specific values.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillation for shapes.
Mod Random sets the amount of randomness in mod frequency.
Shape gives choices for the modulation wave.
Vary Aspect lets the widths of spires vary in each direction.
Squares has options for spacing the spires.
Random Seed changes randomized parameters.

Hexagons Z makes a hexagonal grid displacing in Z.
Fold adds triangular oscillations if positive or a single fold if negative.
Flatten adds soft limiting to the top if positive or clipping if negative.
Octaves add repetition at smaller scales.
Freq Ratio adjusts the scale between octaves.
Roughness sets the height ratio between octaves.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Random Octs randomizes octaves with Blend if positive or Roughness if negative.
Floor adds flat space between hexagons.

Extrude Z extrudes the shape in the -Z direction.
Scale sets the size at the end of extrusion, if Amount is 1 or more.
Wave Amount, Freq and Shape set the properties of a wave to vary the extrusion size.
Flatten truncates the top of the extrusion.
Reflect Z mirrors the extrusion in Z.

Riemann Sphr maps the XY plane to a Riemann sphere, with the origin at the south pole and infinity at the north pole.
Scale is the radius of a circle that maps to the equator.
Thickness is how much the Z position modulates the sphere radius.
South Pole chooses the direction to orient the sphere.

Paving Polar makes random block patterns in polar coordinates displacing radially.
Frequency sets the density of the pattern.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Axibots displaces axially with varied numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Gabor Noise creates random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied by Angle Variation.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Abs Ripples uses the absolute value of ripples for octaves.

Maze Polar displaces in a polar maze pattern around the Y axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.

Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.

Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Long Density adjusts the number of longitudinal walls.

Gumowski-Mira is a chaotic attractor, with very sensitive dependence on the A and B parameters.
A provides most of the pattern variation. It works on an iterator with Scales 100 and Rotation and Position 0.
B values above 1 expand and below 1 contract.
Scale adjusts the pattern size, and does affect the pattern.
Nudge adds a small shift to the pattern to help it expand, and is necessary for some settings. Small values increase pattern density but can be slower to appear.
Z Scale sets the percentage of Z to keep at each iteration.

Maze Circle displaces vertically in a circular maze pattern around the Z axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Outside Corners can be sharp or round.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Tubey makes a tubular inversion around the Y axis, with optional spikes.
Tube Shape chooses circular or square tube.
Scale adjusts the inversion radius.
Damping reduces strength of inversion.
Spike Mix mixes between tube and spike effects.
Spike Rate sets the frequency for spikes.
Twist adds a rotation along the Y axis.

Wood Grain makes banded noise good for wood or agate coloring, usually without displacement.
Mapping sets the direction of banding.
Banding and Noise Type and Noise Shape give different characteristics.
Noise Scale sets the noise size relative to banding.
Noise Amount sets how perturbed the banding is.
Octaves add copies of the basic pattern with different frequencies and amounts.
Roughness sets the relative amount of each octave.
Smoothing reduces the effect of higher octaves.

KleinJorgensen is a Kleinian generator using Jorgensen's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root inverts the shape.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Grandma is a Kleinian generator using Grandma's normalization. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root switches between two variations.
Symmetric uses a symmetric normalization to show rotational symmetry, when Trace C has magnitude less than 2.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Riley is a Kleinian generator using Riley's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The A complex values determine the shape.
Interval Type sets the repetition distance along X. Set to 0 for 2, 1 for 1, higher for resonances.
D y adds vertical shift to the horizontal repetitions.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Gabor Noise3D creates random 3D ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing radially.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses and absolute values of ripples.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.

Angle X Var and Angle Z Var set amount of angle variation around X and Z axes.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Z Angle rotates the ripples around Z, per octave.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Moomin warps with axial sine oscillations.
Scaler adjusts the strength of axial effects.
Frequency adjusts the rate of oscillation.
Phase shifts the oscillation phase.
Axial Mod adjusts the effect along axes.
`7g

Apollonian makes an Apollonian gasket. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation. It is cleaner than Klein Grandma can make.
There are no parameters.

Gyroidal displaces radially based on a gyroid formula.
Scale adjusts the pattern size.
Shape adjusts curvature of the pattern.
Ripples adds waves to the displacement, with absolute value if negative.
Ripple Area sets how the ripples affect upper or lower areas.
Flatten High flattens, or truncates if negative, from the top.
Flatten Low flattens, or truncates if negative, from the bottom.

Truchet 2 Ax displaces in two point Truchet patterns in the six axial directions.

Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Face Seed chooses the same or different randomness per face.
Align Grid chooses even or odd grid spacing in each face.

Karakusa Pol makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing radially with polar coordinates.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Geometry gives a choice of cylindrical or spherical coordinates.
Scale sets the pattern size.

Obelisk Ax makes a grid of square spires displacing in each axis.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Random Ht varies the height randomly.
Quantize Ht limits random height to specific values.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillation for shapes.
Mod Random sets the amount of randomness in mod frequency.
Shape gives choices for the modulation wave.
Vary Aspect lets the widths of spires vary in each direction.
Squares has options for spacing the spires.
Random Seed changes randomized parameters.

Hexagons Z makes a hexagonal grid displacing in Z.
Fold adds triangular oscillations if positive or a single fold if negative.
Flatten adds soft limiting to the top if positive or clipping if negative.
Octaves add repetition at smaller scales.
Freq Ratio adjusts the scale between octaves.
Roughness sets the height ratio between octaves.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Random Octs randomizes octaves with Blend if positive or Roughness if negative.
Floor adds flat space between hexagons.

Extrude Z extrudes the shape in the -Z direction.
Scale sets the size at the end of extrusion, if Amount is 1 or more.
Wave Amount, Freq and Shape set the properties of a wave to vary the extrusion size.
Flatten truncates the top of the extrusion.
Reflect Z mirrors the extrusion in Z.

Riemann Sphr maps the XY plane to a Riemann sphere, with the origin at the south pole and infinity at the north pole.
Scale is the radius of a circle that maps to the equator.
Thickness is how much the Z position modulates the sphere radius.
South Pole chooses the direction to orient the sphere.

Paving Polar makes random block patterns in polar coordinates displacing radially.
Frequency sets the density of the pattern.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Axibots displaces axially with varied numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Gabor Noise creates random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied by Angle Variation.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Abs Ripples uses the absolute value of ripples for octaves.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Maze Polar displaces in a polar maze pattern around the Y axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Long Density adjusts the number of longitudinal walls.

Gumowski-Mira is a chaotic attractor, with very sensitive dependence on the A and B parameters.
A provides most of the pattern variation. It works on an iterator with Scales 100 and Rotation and Position 0.
B values above 1 expand and below 1 contract.
Scale adjusts the pattern size, and does affect the pattern.
Nudge adds a small shift to the pattern to help it expand, and is necessary for some settings. Small values increase pattern density but can be slower to appear.
Z Scale sets the percentage of Z to keep at each iteration.

Maze Circle displaces vertically in a circular maze pattern around the Z axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Outside Corners can be sharp or round.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Tubey makes a tubular inversion around the Y axis, with optional spikes.
Tube Shape chooses circular or square tube.
Scale adjusts the inversion radius.
Damping reduces strength of inversion.
Spike Mix mixes between tube and spike effects.
Spike Rate sets the frequency for spikes.
Twist adds a rotation along the Y axis.

Wood Grain makes banded noise good for wood or agate coloring, usually without displacement.
Mapping sets the direction of banding.
Banding and Noise Type and Noise Shape give different characteristics.
Noise Scale sets the noise size relative to banding.
Noise Amount sets how perturbed the banding is.
Octaves add copies of the basic pattern with different frequencies and amounts.
Roughness sets the relative amount of each octave.
Smoothing reduces the effect of higher octaves.

KleinJorgensen is a Kleinian generator using Jorgensen's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root inverts the shape.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Grandma is a Kleinian generator using Grandma's normalization. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root switches between two variations.
Symmetric uses a symmetric normalization to show rotational symmetry, when Trace C has magnitude less than 2.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Riley is a Kleinian generator using Riley's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The A complex values determine the shape.
Interval Type sets the repetition distance along X. Set to 0 for 2, 1 for 1, higher for resonances.
D y adds vertical shift to the horizontal repetitions.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Gabor Noise3D creates random 3D ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing radially.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses and absolute values of ripples.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle X Var and Angle Z Var set amount of angle variation around X and Z axes.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Z Angle rotates the ripples around Z, per octave.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Moomin warps with axial sine oscillations.
Scaler adjusts the strength of axial effects.
Frequency adjusts the rate of oscillation.
Phase shifts the oscillation phase.
Axial Mod adjusts the effect along axes.
`7g

Apollonian makes an Apollonian gasket. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation. It is cleaner than Klein Grandma can make.
There are no parameters.

Gyroidal displaces radially based on a gyroid formula.
Scale adjusts the pattern size.
Shape adjusts curvature of the pattern.
Ripples adds waves to the displacement, with absolute value if negative.
Ripple Area sets how the ripples affect upper or lower areas.
Flatten High flattens, or truncates if negative, from the top.
Flatten Low flattens, or truncates if negative, from the bottom.

Truchet 2 Ax displaces in two point Truchet patterns in the six axial directions.
Scale adjusts how many tiles in each face.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles. Patterns 25 and up are random.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Face Seed chooses whether each face is identical, has different randomness, or random patterns.

normalized_result.value:
Perlin noise is a smoothly varying random noise.
Type gives a choice of combination of 2D or 3D, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.

Hexagons makes a hexagonal grid.
Shape sets the profile in each hexagon.
Fold adjusts the position of a fold in the profile.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Bricks makes a grid of brick shapes.
Layout sets the brick pattern.
Mortar sets the gap between bricks.
Dimension chooses 2D or 3D brick shape.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Cell 2D makes 2D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Distance sets the combination of distances to the nearest cell centers.
Metric is how the distance is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.

Cell 3D makes 3D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Distance sets the combination of distances to the nearest cell centers.
Metric is how the distance is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.

Paving 2D makes 2D paving patterns of subdivided blocks.
Shape sets the overall shape of blocks, with variations in amount of splitting.
Height sets how the height of subdivided blocks varies.
Levels sets how many times to split.
Mortar sets the gap between blocks (not for Height Cell ID or Across).
Seed varies the randomness, with negative values for repeated 2x2 patterns.
Profile sets the shape within each block.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Paving 3D makes 3D paving patterns of subdivided blocks.
Shape sets the shape of blocks, with variations in amount of splitting.
Height sets how the height of subdivided blocks varies.
Levels sets how many times to split.
Mortar sets the gap between blocks.
Seed varies the randomness, with negative values for repeated 2x2 patterns.
Profile sets the shape within each block.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Gabor Rand makes random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution.
Min Freq sets the ripple frequency. Ripples are summed if positive, maximum value if negative.
Freq Var is how much the ripple frequency varies randomly; negative to take absolute value of ripples.
Phase Var adds random phase shifts to the impulses.
Angle Var is how much the ripple angle varies randomly.
Profile sets the shape of impulses.

Gabor Tile makes repeating tile patterns with sparse Gabor convolution.
Min Freq sets the ripple frequency. Ripples are summed if negative, otherwise maximum value.
Freq Var is how much the ripple frequency varies, with the pattern if positive or randomly if negative.
Phase Var is how much impulse phase varies in the pattern; negative to use absolute ripple values.
Angle Var varies the ripple angle with the pattern, slightly random if negative.
Pattern sets the tile pattern. 0-30 regular; 31-32 vary smoothly; 33-69 alternate regular and random; 70-199 random framed; 200-400 random 2x2 framed; -1..-199 random 2x2; -200..-400 random.

Karakusa makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Seed varies the random aspects.
Profile sets how the ring height varies.

Scales makes a fish scale pattern.
Shape has choices of scale shape.
Random Mix blends with randomness if negative or adds randomness if positive.

Parquet makes traditional floor tiling patterns.
Pattern chooses a tile layout.
Shape sets the relation between pattern and height.
ID Mix blends between the shape and tile ID.
Gaps sets distance between tiles.
Random Mix adds random offsets to the height of each tile.

Cell Ripple2D makes localized circular ripples in a random 2D grid.
Frequency sets the ripple frequency.
Falloff is how fast the ripples reduce from the center.
Height Var varies ripple height randomly.
Phase adjusts the phase of the ripple waves.
Phase Var adds randomness to the phase at each ripple center.

Cell Ripple3D makes localized circular ripples in a random 3D grid.
Frequency sets the ripple frequency.
Falloff is how fast the ripples reduce from the center.
Height Var varies ripple strength randomly.
Phase Var adds randomness to the phase at each ripple center.
Density sets the number of ripple centers in each cube.

Stripes makes randomly connected stripes.
Crossovers sets the percentage of connection between stripes in each pair.
Interlace is how much line pairs interact.
Line Width sets the relative thickness of stripes.
Profile sets the shape of stripe height.
Seed varies the randomness. Negative values make repeating 4x4 patterns.

Cell Stars 2D makes star shapes in a random 2D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Cell Stars 3D makes star shapes in a random 3D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Truchet 1 displaces in one point Truchet patterns in the Z direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Mono Mix blends between linear and binary output.

Truchet 2 displaces in two point Truchet patterns in the Z direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles. Patterns 25 and up are random.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Mono Mix blends between linear and binary output.

Perlin is a smoothly varying random noise.
Type gives a choice of combination of dimensions, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.
Shape adjusts the curvature of the distortion.

Cell 2D distorts with 2D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Mode chooses the distortion pattern.
Metric is how the distance to cells is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.
Shape varies the response curve of the distortion.

Cell 3D distorts with 3D random cell noise (Voronoi).
Mode chooses the distortion pattern.
Metric is how the distance to cells is measured.
Density is the number of cells in a square.
Seed varies the randomness.
Shape varies the response curve of the distortion.

Perlin Rad is a smoothly varying random noise with radial orientation.
Type gives a choice of combination of dimensions, value or gradient noise, and Perlin or Simplex method.
Geometry sets cylindrical or spherical displacement.
Curve adjusts the profile of the noise amplitude.
Radial sets how the relative displacement varies with radius.

Mesh makes a triangle mesh, opened from a file.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Face Order sets triangle drawing order. Random is best for previewing, Sequential is smoother and faster.
Scaling options set the mesh to a workable size for the holon scaling to adjust.
Centered automatically centers the mesh.
File is the filename; currently a .obj, .ply, or .stl file.
The maximum number of triangles is currently 10 million.

Planet1 is a spherical terrain made from octaves of Perlin or Simplex noise.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Detail sets whether the roughness is constant or reducing at higher octaves.
Direction limits displacement directions.
Random Seed chooses different random terrains.

Planet2 is a spherical terrain made from octaves of Perlin or Simplex noise, with slope modification.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Slope mod lets you adjust height of octaves depending on the local slope.
Direction limits displacement directions.
Random Seed chooses different random terrains.

Grid Cubic displaces towards the edges of a cubic grid.
Diamonds makes diamond shaped pieces instead of rectangular.
Random adds variation to each cell. Positive to set a threshold for displacing; negative to vary the amount.

Grid Spheric displaces towards a spherical grid.
Diamonds makes diamond shaped pieces instead of rectangular.
The longitude and latitude frequencies can be adjusted independently.
Random adds variation to each cell. Positive to set a threshold for displacing; negative to vary the amount.
Random Seed varies the randomness.

Paving 2D makes random block patterns with Z displacement.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Random Seed changes the randomization. Negative values give regular 2x2 patterns.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Cp Rectangle makes copies in a rectangle along X and Y.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Aspect varies the X spacing.
Stagger offsets alternate rows in X and/or Z.
Alt Rows inverts or rotates copies in alternate rows.
Alt Columns inverts or rotates copies in alternate columns.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Circle makes copies of the holon around a circle or arc.
Copies is the number of copies.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Radius sets the X displacement of the first copy.
Arc is the angle around the circle used for copies.
Orient rotates each copy by its position around the circle.
Rotate Y is the relative rotation around the orbital axis.
Rotate Z is the relative rotation around the circle.
Alternate options reflect alternating copies across the axes (before Rotations).
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Vortices twists the center of cells in a 2D grid facing Z.
Displace moves the central spire in each cell in the Z direction.
Power biases the vortex curvature toward or away from the center.
Random Amt varies the amount per cell.
Shape sets the shape of the boundary for twisting.
Alternate has options for alternating the direction of twisting.

Paving 3D displaces in random block patterns.
The Shapes can be all cubic, mixed dimensions or blocks of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Mortar adds gaps between blocks.
Curve squares up the blocks; set negative to constrain displacement within blocks.
Random Seed changes the randomization.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Cubes or Mixed Shapes.
Profile sets the shape of each block displacement.

Cp Sphere makes copies in a golden spiral around a sphere.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Offset moves the copies radially.
Orient automatically orients each copy away from the center, relative to vertical.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.
Radial Mod varies the radius with a sine wave set by Mod Frequency, negative for Abs Sine.

Cp Fibspire2 makes copies with log Fibonacci spiral packing, flat or in a spire with choice of four shapes.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Conic makes copies in rings in a conic section.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Stagger offsets alternate rings, good for bricks.
Rot Z Vert adds progressive Z rotation per ring.
Rot Z Horz adds progressive Z rotation around the rings.
Rot Y Horz adds progressive Y rotation around the rings.
Alt Ring reflects copies outwards for alternate rings.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cell Split cuts into pieces using 3D cell noise (Voronoi).
Warp bends the pieces towards the cell shape.
Metric determines the shape at each point.
Cell density is the number of points per cell.
Random Seed changes random aspects.

Karakusa Z makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing in Z.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.

Kara Cut Z makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, cutting stencils in the Z plane.
Amount cuts towards the center of rings if positive, or towards the edges if negative.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Prioritize prefers overlapping rings to joins.

Karakusa Ax makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing in the nearest axial direction.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Face Seed chooses the same or different randomness per face.
Align Grid chooses even or odd grid spacing in each face.

Karakusa Pol makes tiled Karakusa patterns from concentric rings, displacing radially with polar coordinates.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of ring patterns and tiles. 85 and up are randomized; 100 up have discrete tiles.
Shapes set the arrangement of four ring shapes. Some have randomness.
Zones varies the assignment of ring priorities for overlays or joins.
Line Width varies the width of each ring.
Profile is the shape of the ring displacement.
Geometry gives a choice of cylindrical or spherical coordinates.
Scale sets the pattern size.

Maze Z displaces in a rectangular maze pattern facing Z.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Density adjusts the number of walls.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Periodic sets the size of repeating square blocks.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.

Obelisk Ax makes a grid of square spires displacing in each axis.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Random Ht varies the height randomly.
Quantize Ht limits random height to specific values.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillation for shapes.
Mod Random sets the amount of randomness in mod frequency.
Shape gives choices for the modulation wave.
Vary Aspect lets the widths of spires vary in each direction.
Squares has options for spacing the spires.
Random Seed changes randomized parameters.

Hexagons Z makes a hexagonal grid displacing in Z.
Fold adds triangular oscillations if positive or a single fold if negative.
Flatten adds soft limiting to the top if positive or clipping if negative.
Octaves add repetition at smaller scales.
Freq Ratio adjusts the scale between octaves.
Roughness sets the height ratio between octaves.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Random Octs randomizes octaves with Blend if positive or Roughness if negative.
Floor adds flat space between hexagons.

Bristler displaces radially with sharp or rounded spines.
Random Height varies the bristle height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of bristles.
Shape chooses round or sharp bristles.
Bubble Amount adds oscillation to the bristle thickness.
Bubble Freq adjusts the rate of oscillation, with negative values randomized.
Helix Amount adds a twist to the bristles.
Helix Freq sets the rate of twist, with negative values adding random phase.
Width adjusts the width of the bristles.

Sliders makes randomized sliding windows in a cubic grid.
Directions sets the number of axes to move in.
Move can be in one random direction or all directions.
Move From sets where in each cell to open the window.
Reduction randomly reduces the window in each cell; positive to use a threshold or negative for even distribution.
Random Seed changes the random distribution.
Warp adds triangular shapes to the windows.

Paving Polar makes random block patterns in polar coordinates displacing radially.
Frequency sets the density of the pattern.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Hairwave displaces radially with hairs that bend in various ways.
Random Height varies the hair height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of hairs.
Shape chooses the hair profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Wave Frequency adjusts the rate of wave changes.
Wave Shape gives a choice of wave patterns.
Jitter adds random direction to each hair.
Curve adjusts the bend of the hairs, with a different curve when negative.
Width adjusts the width of the hairs.
Mod Frequency adds sine ripples to the width if positive or scallops if negative.

Reedy displaces vertically with stalks that bend in various ways.
Random Height varies the stalk height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of stalks.
Shape chooses the stalk profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Wave Frequency adjusts the rate of wave changes.
Wave Shape gives a choice of wave patterns.
Jitter adds random direction to each stalk.
Curve adjusts the bend of the stalks, with a different curve when negative.
Width adjusts the width of the stalks.
Mod Frequency adds sine ripples to the width if positive or scallops if negative.
Blade flattens the stalks; positive in the bend direction, negative in the Z direction.

Hairparter displaces radially with hairs that around or towards/away from poles.
Random Height varies the hair height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of hairs.
Shape chooses the hair profile.
Wave Amount bends the hairs in wave patterns.
Parting sets the directions of bending.
Jitter adds random sideways shift to the bend of each hair.
Curve adjusts the bend of the hairs, with a different curve when negative.
Width adjusts the width of the hairs.
Taper reduces hair height toward the poles; linear if positive, domed if negative.
Mod Frequency adds sine ripples to the width if positive or scallops if negative.

Botsy displaces vertically with a numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Axibots displaces axially with varied numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Gabor Noise creates random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied by Angle Variation.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Abs Ripples uses the absolute value of ripples for octaves.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Gabor Tile creates repeating patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Pattern sets the tile pattern. 0-30 regular; 31-32 vary smoothly; 33-69 alternate regular and random; 70-199 random framed; 200-400 random 2x2 framed; -1..-199 random 2x2; -200..-400 random.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied within the pattern by Angle Variation.
Phase Variation shifts the phase of each impulse within the patttern.
Options set whether to use maximum or absolute values.
Envelope sets the shape of the impulses. Most useful with Min Frequency 0 and Max option.

Parquet Z makes tiling patterns in the Z plane, good for coloring with optional displacement.
Displace adds a rounded displacement to each tile in the Z direction.
Pattern sets the tile pattern.

Scales makes a fish scale pattern.

Paving 2D makes random block patterns with Z displacement.

JuliaN is the 2D complex Julia set Z^N+C.

Auger combines stretching, ribs and twisting on each of the six axes.

Obelisk Ax makes a grid of square spires displacing in each axis.

Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Twist adds a rotation along the Y axis.

Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Gabor Noise creates random ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing in Z.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle rotates the ripples, varied by Angle Variation.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Abs Ripples uses the absolute value of ripples for octaves.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Maze Polar displaces in a polar maze pattern around the Y axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Long Density adjusts the number of longitudinal walls.

Gumowski-Mira is a chaotic attractor, with very sensitive dependence on the A and B parameters.
A provides most of the pattern variation. It works on an iterator with Scales 100 and Rotation and Position 0.
B values above 1 expand and below 1 contract.
Scale adjusts the pattern size, and does affect the pattern.
Nudge adds a small shift to the pattern to help it expand, and is necessary for some settings. Small values increase pattern density but can be slower to appear.
Z Scale sets the percentage of Z to keep at each iteration.

Maze Circle displaces vertically in a circular maze pattern around the Z axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Outside Corners can be sharp or round.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Tubey makes a tubular inversion around the Y axis, with optional spikes.
Tube Shape chooses circular or square tube.
Scale adjusts the inversion radius.
Damping reduces strength of inversion.
Spike Mix mixes between tube and spike effects.
Spike Rate sets the frequency for spikes.
Twist adds a rotation along the Y axis.

Wood Grain makes banded noise good for wood or agate coloring, usually without displacement.
Mapping sets the direction of banding.
Banding and Noise Type and Noise Shape give different characteristics.
Noise Scale sets the noise size relative to banding.
Noise Amount sets how perturbed the banding is.
Octaves add copies of the basic pattern with different frequencies and amounts.
Roughness sets the relative amount of each octave.
Smoothing reduces the effect of higher octaves.

KleinJorgensen is a Kleinian generator using Jorgensen's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root inverts the shape.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Grandma is a Kleinian generator using Grandma's normalization. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The traces determine the shape.
Root switches between two variations.
Symmetric uses a symmetric normalization to show rotational symmetry, when Trace C has magnitude less than 2.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Klein Riley is a Kleinian generator using Riley's normalization, repeating along X. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation.
The A complex values determine the shape.
Interval Type sets the repetition distance along X. Set to 0 for 2, 1 for 1, higher for resonances.
D y adds vertical shift to the horizontal repetitions.
Spiral Enhance increases density of spirals, but can add stray points. Set small for pure gaskets.

Gabor Noise3D creates random 3D ripple patterns with sparse Gabor convolution displacing radially.
Options choose whether to use absolute and sum or maximum values of impulses and absolute values of ripples.
Min Frequency sets the ripple frequency, with wider envelope if negative.
Freq Variation varies frequency of the ripples.
Angle X Var and Angle Z Var set amount of angle variation around X and Z axes.
Octaves combine copies of the pattern at different scales, with adjustable frequency ratio and roughness.
Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.
Z Angle rotates the ripples around Z, per octave.
Randomness options choose whether to randomize phase or amount of impulses to make ripples.

Moomin warps with axial sine oscillations.
Scaler adjusts the strength of axial effects.
Frequency adjusts the rate of oscillation.
Phase shifts the oscillation phase.
Axial Mod adjusts the effect along axes.
`7g

Apollonian makes an Apollonian gasket. Use on an iterator with Scales 100 and no Skew or Rotation. It is cleaner than Klein Grandma can make.
There are no parameters.

Gyroidal displaces radially based on a gyroid formula.
Scale adjusts the pattern size.
Shape adjusts curvature of the pattern.
Ripples adds waves to the displacement, with absolute value if negative.
Ripple Area sets how the ripples affect upper or lower areas.
Flatten High flattens, or truncates if negative, from the top.
Flatten Low flattens, or truncates if negative, from the bottom.

Truchet 2 Ax displaces in two point Truchet patterns in the six axial directions.
Scale adjusts how many tiles in each face.
Pattern chooses the arrangement of tiles. Patterns 25 and up are random.
Shapes sets the choice of circle or diamond shapes for each tile.
Profile sets the shape of the lines.
Line Width sets the width of the lines.
Random Seed chooses different random patterns when applicable.
Face Seed chooses whether each face is identical, has different randomness, or random patterns.
Setting bit transparency color is not allowed for png images containing alpha value for each pixel (COLOR_RGBALPHA and COLOR_GRAYSCALEALPHA)

Grids makes a regular grid of simple shapes.
Cells sets the pattern for which cells in the grid are occupied.
Profile sets the shape of each cell.
Stagger offsets alternate rows in X and/or Z.
Dimension sets a 2D or 3D grid.
Shrink reduces the size of the shape in each cell.

Cell Stars 2D makes star shapes in a random 2D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Cell Stars 3D makes star shapes in a random 3D grid.
Points sets the star symmetry, negative for slimmer stars.
Size is the size of the stars. Negative values add random heights to the stars, allowing colors to differ.
Shape gives a choice of star shape.
Density sets the number of stars in each grid cell.
Seed varies the random aspects. Negative values orient the stars randomly.

Screwhead is the head of a screw or rivet, or a conic with rounding options.
Slope makes the sides slope in or out.
Rounding adds rounded edges if positive or bevels if negative.
Groove sets the size of the groove across the head.
Crossed makes two perpendicular grooves.
Dimple adds a depression in the center of the head.

Rotor is a flat-bladed rotor, fan or circular saw.
Clip truncates the end of the blades, and also adds a gap if negative.
Hole sets the size of the hole at the center.
Pitch turns the blades along the Z axis.
Twist bends the blades around the axis.
Saw Set bends alternate blades either side of the rotor disc.
Fixed Size keeps the outer radius constant by scaling the disc down when blade size is increased.

Tyrus is a torus with a variety of tread patterns, good for tyres.
Thickness is the tube size; positive for circular, negative for squarer.
Cover is how much of the surface has tread.
Tread is the height of the tread pattern.
Pattern Lat repeats along the shaft.
Pattern Long repeats around the shaft.
Clip Lat and Clip Long clip the top or bottom of the patterns.
Bias shifts the zero point for multiplying the patterns together.
Twist adds a slant to the tread, mirrored if negative.
