Cog is a cog or gear wheel.
Clip truncates the end of the teeth, and also adds a gap if negative.
Hole sets the size of the hole at the center.
Width is the distance from front to back.
Twist bends the teeth around the axis.
Slew turns the teeth along the axis.
Bevel increases the back radius.
Angled/Pitch tapers tooth thickness if positive, or if negative, adds pitch for a fan or propeller.

Orbits is a set of rods whose ends orbit two circles or ellipses.
Steps is the number of starting points in the first orbit, with radius 1.
Period 2 is the relative frequency of the second orbit.
Elliptic 1 and 2 make each orbit elliptical.
Radius 2 is the size of the second orbit.
Phase shifts the ending points around orbit 2.
Angle X rotates orbit 2 around X.
Angle Z rotates orbit 2 around Z.
Offset X and Z move the position of orbit 2.
Thickness sets the thickness of the rods, with automatic adjustment for number of rods.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles.

Point Cloud makes a point cloud, opened from a file.
Point Size sets the relative size for a sphere at each point.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Scaling options set the point cloud to a workable size for the holon scaling to adjust.
Centered automatically centers the point cloud.
File is the filename; currently a .ply or .prt file.
The maximum number of points is currently 20 million.

Mesh makes a triangle mesh, opened from a file.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Face Order sets triangle drawing order. Random is best for previewing, Sequential is smoother and faster.
Scaling options set the mesh to a workable size for the holon scaling to adjust.
Centered automatically centers the mesh.
File is the filename; currently a .obj, .ply, or .stl file.
The maximum number of triangles is currently 10 million.

Paving 2D makes random block patterns with Z displacement.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Random Seed changes the randomization. Negative values give regular 2x2 patterns.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Cp Rectangle makes copies in a rectangle along X and Y.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Aspect varies the X spacing.
Stagger offsets alternate rows in X and/or Z.
Alt Rows inverts or rotates copies in alternate rows.
Alt Columns inverts or rotates copies in alternate columns.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Circle makes copies of the holon around a circle or arc.
Copies is the number of copies.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Radius sets the X displacement of the first copy.
Arc is the angle around the circle used for copies.
Orient rotates each copy by its position around the circle.
Rotate Y is the relative rotation around the orbital axis.
Rotate Z is the relative rotation around the circle.
Alternate options reflect alternating copies across the axes (before Rotations).
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp CubeSym makes 24 copies in cubic symmetry.
Size adjusts the size of each copy.
Radius is the size of the cube.
Corner Shift moves copies towards the cube corners.
Symmetry can be reflection or rotation within each face.
Facing is the axis around which the symmetry works.

Paving 3D displaces in random block patterns.
The Shapes can be all cubic, mixed dimensions or blocks of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.

Wave Amount, Freq and Shape set the properties of a wave to vary the extrusion size.
Flatten truncates the top of the extrusion.
Reflect Z mirrors the extrusion in Z.

Paving Polar makes random block patterns in polar coordinates displacing radially.
Frequency sets the density of the pattern.
The Shapes can be all square, mixed rectangles, or rectangles of minimum width.
Levels is the number of levels of subdivision.
The height can be scaled by level, or randomized.
Bubble expands blocks laterally.
Flatten squares up the blocks if positive, or truncates them if negative.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks, for Squares or Rectangles.
Mortar Gap adds gaps between blocks.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Profile sets the shape of each block.

Botsy displaces vertically with a numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Axibots displaces axially with varied numbers of spires in each square.
Random Height varies the spire height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Scale adjusts the number of spires in each face.
Subdivisions is how many spires in each direction; positive for random.
Shape is the spire shape.
Crossed % is the percentage of squares with the spires crossed in the middle.
Twist adds helical displacement to each square.
Twist Radius sets the size of the twist displacement. Set negative for random variation.
Random Angle varies the amount of twist.
Taper slopes the spires towards the middle; positive for linear or negative for curved.

Cp Spiral makes copies of diminishing size in a vertical spiral with direction in or out.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Radius sets the width of the spiral.
Height sets the spiral height.
Shape gives four profile choices.
Pitch sets the rate of turn around the Y axis.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Height Mod sets the frequency to vary the height; bipolar if negative.

Extrude Shell extrudes the shape in a spiral around the Y axis.
Height shifts the spiral point up or down.
Radius moves the shape along X before extruding.
Pitch adds helical shift along the axis.
Start Angle shifts the extrusion around the axis.
Twist adds rotations around the spiral path.
Modulation controls vary the size in repeating waves, for ribbed effects. Negative Frequency inverts the wave.
Note: extrusion works best with shapes made of thin lines.

Maze Polar displaces in a polar maze pattern around the Y axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Corners sets the shape of outside corners.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Geometry allows choice of vertical coordinates.
Long Density adjusts the number of longitudinal walls.

Spikes displaces axially with rounded or sharp spikes.
Shape gives a choice of spike shape.
Frequency sets the density of spikes.
Ridges adds ridges between the spikes.
Damping reduces the spike size away from each axis; positive before ripples or negative after flattening.
Ripples adds sine ripples to the spikes.
Flatten boosts the spikes and truncates the tops.
Mutation adds variation to the spike shape.

Gumowski-Mira is a chaotic attractor, with very sensitive dependence on the A and B parameters.
A provides most of the pattern variation. It works on an iterator with Scales 100 and Rotation and Position 0.
B values above 1 expand and below 1 contract.
Scale adjusts the pattern size, and does affect the pattern.
Nudge adds a small shift to the pattern to help it expand, and is necessary for some settings. Small values increase pattern density but can be slower to appear.
Z Scale sets the percentage of Z to keep at each iteration.

Cube Lattice 1 makes a cubic lattice of rods and balls or cubes. Always has effect.
Ball Size is the size of the corner shapes.
Ball Shape chooses whether corners are spheres or cubes.
Ball Random adds random variation to ball size.
Rod Shape sets the profile of connecting rods.
Rod Size sets the rod thickness.
Mod Shape sets the waveform for rod oscillations.
Mod Amount adds oscillations to the rod thickness.
Mod Frequency sets the rate of oscillations.
Spring adds helical coils to the rods. Negative values make a variable pitch spring.

Cube Lattice 2 makes a cubic lattice of rods and cubes. Always has effect.
Cube Size is the size of the corner cubes.
Rod Shape sets the profile of connecting rods.
Rod Size sets the rod thickness.
Number Rods sets the number and arrangement of connecting rods.
Spring adds helical coils to the rods. Negative values make a variable pitch spring.

Maze Circle displaces vertically in a circular maze pattern around the Z axis.
Scale sets the pattern size.
Wall Density adjusts the number of walls.
Lat Ratio sets the balance between latitude and longitude walls.
Wall Width sets the wall thickness.
Profile gives choices of wall shape.
Outside Corners can be sharp or round.
Random Seed changes the wall locations.
Wall Curve squares up the walls if positive or adds ripples if negative.
Radial Density adjusts the number of radial walls.

Bubblewrap makes a 3D grid of bubbles. May be slow in places.
Radius sets the size of the bubbles.
Stagger offsets alternate rows of holes.
Warp changes the hole shape from circular, with choice of two shapes.

Cp Ringstar makes copies in a ring of radial arms.
Num Arms is the number of radial arms.
Num Rings is the number of concentric rings.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Pre-Rotate options change orientation before rotation.
Alt Arms options invert every second arm in specified directions.
Alt Rings options invert every second ring in specified directions.
Rotate X adds rotation of copies around X along the arms.
Twist Z twists the arms around the Z axis.
Orientation rotates positions between a flat ring and a cylinder.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Rings makes copies in concentric rings.
Num Rings is the number of concentric rings.
First Ring is the size of the inner ring.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Pre-Rotate options change orientation before rotation.
Alt Around options invert every second copy in the ring in specified directions.
Alt Rings options invert every second ring in specified directions.
Rotate X adds rotation of copies around X along the arms.
Twist Z twists the arms around the Z axis.
Cone displaces the center of the ring in a cone towards Z.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Ladder makes copies in a vertical ladder.
Num Steps is the number of steps or rungs. Set negative to center vertically.
Top Step puts a step at the top.
Rotate Side rotates the side copies.
Rotate Step rotates the step copies.
Size sets the size of each copy.
Num High is the number of side copies between steps.
Num Wide is the number of copies in steps.
Step Stretch adjusts the width of steps.
Num Deep is the number of copies in the Z direction.
Z Spacing adjusts spacing in the Z direction when Num Deep is 2 or more.
Twist rotates the ladder into a double helix.
Taper makes the ladder narrower towards the top.

Dice makes a six-sided die with one to six spots on each face.
Margin sets the size of the area outside the spots.
Direction sets the orientation.
Flatten truncates the top of the spots.

Wood Grain makes banded noise good for wood or agate coloring, usually without displacement.
Mapping sets the direction of banding.
Banding and Noise Type and Noise Shape give different characteristics.
Noise Scale sets the noise size relative to banding.
Noise Amount sets how perturbed the banding is.
Octaves add copies of the basic pattern with different frequencies and amounts.
Roughness sets the relative amount of each octave.
Smoothing reduces the effect of higher octaves.

Molecular makes a random lattice of rods and balls. Always has effect.
Ball Size is the size of the balls.
Ball Random adds random variation to ball size.
Rod Size sets the rod thickness.
Cell Density sets the number of points in each cell.
Random Seed changes the random arrangement.

Cp Cubic makes copies in a cubic shape with variable dimensions.
Size is the relative size of each copy.
Alternate inverts alternatecopies in a choice of directions.
Rotate X, Y and Z add progressive rotation around each axis.
Stagger offsets alternate rows in various directions.
Jitter Rot adds randomness to the rotations.
Jitter Pos adds randomness to the position of each copy.
Random Seed changes the random results for jittering; negative to constrain Jitter Pos to the XY plane.

Folder folds the right side around a circular arc, with optional oscillation along X.
Turns sets the amount of folding, with each turn being a complete circle.
Radius sets the size of the folding circle.
Wave Amount adds oscillation along X, with specified Frequency and Wave Shape.
Wave Area has options to limit waves to left or right.
Clip Wave truncates the wave tops if positive, or the base if negative.

Cp Torus makes copies in a torus.
Width is the torus width.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Flatten squashes towards a cylinder if positive or plate if negative.
Size adjusts the size of copies.
Twists adds rotation around the torus.
Pre-rotate changes the orientation of copies.
Orient adjusts orientation to the torus.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Cp Arch makes copies in an arch along X.
Copies X is the number of copies along the arch.
Arch Shape sets the shape of vertical displacement.
Height is the height of the arch.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Copies Z sets the number of copies for arch width.
Z Spacing adjusts the width of the arch.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Alternate X inverts every second copy in the X direction.
Rotate X adds progressive rotation around the X axis.
Orient adjusts orientation of copies to the arch shape.

Stripes Z makes randomly connected stripes displacing in Z.
Random Seed varies the randomness.
Repeat X and Repeat Y set size of repeating cells in each direction.
Crossovers sets the percentage of connection between stripes in each pair.
Interlace is how much line pairs interact.
Line Width sets the relative thickness of stripes.
Profile sets the shape of stripe height.
Wave Amount adds vertical oscillation to the stripes, with adjustable Frequency and Shape.

Cp Square makes copies of the holon around a square.
Copies is the number of copies per side.
Facing sets the orientation of the square.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Radius sets the size of the square.
Spacing adjusts distance between copies in each side.
Offset shifts the sides off center.
Orient rotates each copy to face the side.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Rotate adds rotation around the Facing axis along each side.
Alternate V inverts alternating copies vertically in each side.

Cp Paver 2D makes copies of the holon in a rectangular arrangement with subdivisions.
Rows and Columns are the number of full size copies per side.
Facing sets the orientation of the rectangle.
Pre-Rotate options reorient to a different axis before copying.
Size sets the relative size of each copy.
Levels is the number of subdivision sizes.
Size Bias shifts the distribution towards larger or smaller blocks.
Empty % sets the probability of cells being empty at each subdivision.
Rotation sets the type of random rotation in each cell.
Unique Seed not zero gives a random unique choice per copy when used on an iterator or group with several members.

Stripes Polar makes randomly connected stripes around Y.
Random Seed varies the randomness.
Long Frequency sets the frequency around the Y axis.
Lat Frequency sets the vertical frequency; positive for Cylindrical geometry, negative for Spherical.
Repeat Y sets size of repeating cells in Y.

Crossovers sets the percentage of connection between stripes in each pair.
Interlace is how much line pairs interact.
Line Width sets the relative thickness of stripes.
Profile sets the shape of stripe height.
Wave Amount adds vertical oscillation to the stripes, with adjustable Frequency and Shape.

Cp Grille Ring makes copies in a grille pattern around a ring.
Width adjusts the grille width.
Orientation rotates between a flat ring and a cylinder.
Density adjusts the number and size of copies.
Size Adjust changes the size of copies.
XY Frequency is the ratio between X and Y oscillation rates.
Wave/Mirror sets the shape of the main curve, with Vertical and Horizontal symmetry options.
Loop Amount adds sine loops to the wave.
Loop Frequency sets the number of vertical loops.
Loop Phase adjusts the phase of the loop oscillations.
Loop Weave sets a rate of interweaving of loops if positive, or toroidal width if negative.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles around the torus.
Twists adds rotation around the coil.

Cp Lissajous makes copies in a 2D or 3D pattern of cyclical sine or triangle waves.
Height adjusts the vertical size.
Wave Shape chooses sine or triangle waves.
Density adjusts the number of copies.
Size Adjust alters the size of copies.
XY Frequency is the ratio between X and Y oscillation.
XY Phase adjusts the phase between X and Y oscillation.
Mod Frequency controls amplitude modulation of the Y wave, with Mod Phase varying the phase.
Z Frequency sets the frequency of Z oscillation. Set to 0 for 2D.
Z Phase adjusts the phase of the Z oscillation.
Completion is the percentage of total cycles to use.
Twists rotates the copies around the cycle direction.

Gyroidal displaces radially based on a gyroid formula.
Scale adjusts the pattern size.
Shape adjusts curvature of the pattern.
Ripples adds waves to the displacement, with absolute value if negative.
Ripple Area sets how the ripples affect upper or lower areas.
Flatten High flattens, or truncates if negative, from the top.
Flatten Low flattens, or truncates if negative, from the bottom.

Mesh makes a triangle mesh, opened from a file.
File Colors sets whether to use colors from the file instead of a gradient.
Face Order sets triangle drawing order. Random is best for previewing, Sequential is smoother and faster.

The maximum number of triangles is currently 10 million.

Profile sets the way the slope varies.
Flatten makes a steeper slope with flat top.
Bias moves the whole surface vertically; mostly useful with modulation or Multiply Input.
Multiply Mix blends between adding and multiplying the input.

Bristler displaces radially with sharp or rounded spines.
Random Height varies the bristle height randomly. Positive values bias towards less variation.
Frequency adjusts the density of bristles.
Shape chooses round or sharp bristles.

Bubble Freq adjusts the rate of oscillation, with negative values randomized.
Helix Amount adds a twist to the bristles.

Width adjusts the width of the bristles.

Wave properties affect oscillation of the ridge.

Flatten makes a steeper slope with flater top if positive, or truncates the top if negative.
Bias moves the whole surface vertically; mostly useful with modulation or Multiply Input.
Multiply Mix blends between adding and multiplying the input.

Mound displaces vertically in a smooth mound, and is also useful for modulating displacement of other metamorphs.
Shape sets the mound outline.
Profile sets the way the slope varies.
Flatten makes a steeper slope with flat top.
Bias moves the whole surface vertically; mostly useful with modulation or Multiply Input.
Multiply Mix blends between adding and multiplying the input.

Seed Group sets a seed point for the group to begin iteration when there are no constructors being iterated. It is useful for pure Julia, Bulb and Quaternion fractals.
Seed Group can be used on any holon in the group (active or not), or on the group itself, but is most convenient to adjust when on the same holon as a fractal metamorph.
The seed point and its iterations can be seen with Shaded Preview off. Adjust the position to move them into the fractal surface. Some fractal shapes need the seed to be in a particular area. Some need Y or Z position to be non-zero.
The Enabled option is a quick way to test the effect.

Hexagons Z makes a hexagonal grid displacing in Z.

Flatten adds soft limiting to the top if positive or clipping if negative.
Octaves add repetition at smaller scales.

Blend mixes between the sum and maximum of octaves.

Warp adds triangular shapes to the windows.

Flatten squares off the tops of ripples.
Random Seed changes the random aspects.

Diamonds makes diamond shaped pieces instead of rectangular.
